title: Toric geometry of ReLU neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2509.05894v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Given a continuous piecewise linear function $f:\mathbb{R}^{n_0} \to \mathbb{R}$ and a fixed architecture of feedforward ReLU neural networks, the exact function realization problem asks when a network of that architecture realizes $f$. In contrast, expressivity concerns characterizing all functions exactly realizable by a given architecture. To address these questions systematically, we establish a connection between toric geometry and ReLU neural networks, allowing tools from algebraic geometry to analyze the structures. Starting with an unbiased ReLU network with rational weights, we define the ReLU fan, the ReLU toric variety, and the ReLU Cartier divisor associated with the network. This work also relates the tropical and the toric geometry: the former captures combinatorial data of ReLU networks, while the latter recovers the underlying geometric structure. translated_abstract: 给定一个连续分段线性函数 $f:\mathbb{R}^{n_0} \to \mathbb{R}$ 和一个固定的前馈ReLU神经网络架构，精确函数实现问题问的是该架构的网络何时能够实现 $f$。与之相对，表达能力问题关注的是刻画由给定架构能够精确实现的所有函数。为了系统地解决这些问题，我们在环面几何与ReLU神经网络之间建立了联系，使得代数几何工具能够用于分析这些结构。从一个具有有理权重的无偏ReLU网络出发，我们定义了与该网络相关联的ReLU扇、ReLU环面簇以及ReLU卡地亚除子。这项工作还将热带几何与环面几何联系起来：前者捕捉ReLU网络的组合数据，而后者则恢复其底层的几何结构。作为应用，我们获得了……的完整刻画。
tldr: 该论文建立了ReLU神经网络与环面几何之间的联系，定义了ReLU扇、ReLU环面簇和ReLU卡地亚除子等新概念，借助代数几何工具系统研究了网络的精确函数实现问题与表达能力，并揭示了热带几何与环面几何之间的对应关系。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a connection between ReLU neural networks and toric geometry by defining the ReLU fan, ReLU toric variety, and ReLU Cartier divisor, enabling algebraic geometry tools to systematically study exact function realization and expressivity, while linking tropical and toric geometry.
